source.description: an address or a host name; a host name is resolved with DNS and its first IPv4 address is checked

destination.description: an address or a host name; a host name is resolved with DNS and its first IPv4 address is checked

protocol.description: tcp, udp, icmp or sctp; no default: a rule that needs it is held back and needs names it

url.description: the URL; it decides URL categories

application.description: recorded, not evaluated; it does not change the answer

user.description: the source user, such as corp\alice

device.description: the firewall the path starts on; left out, the source places the start

router.description: the start's logical router; needs device

at.description: read each device's newest snapshot at or before this time; left out, the latest

detail.description: summary or full: how much of each result to return
